checks: deterministic live capture; AI review and recommendations not tested
scopeNote: AI is explicitly disabled: this measures live source discovery and capture, not source interpretation or recommendation quality. Seeded recapture regression: search observations replay previously recorded URLs; no search-provider request or new discovery/recall measurement. Bounded live synthetic case using production discovery, review, assessment and delivery use cases. Worker reader includes configured browser fallback and Ashby routing without shared Redis caching; HTTP reader is a controlled reduced-access path. Native X and marketplace connector loops are not exercised. All lead rows are measured separately from the dashboard's bounded sample. Matching can remain incomplete if retries exceed the check window. Model labels are not independent ground truth; precision, recall and global throughput remain unproven.

stages.limitations: AI estimates exclude unpriced/failed attempts, infrastructure and billing adjustments. Search reservations are configured upper allowances, not invoices. Source labels and dashboard acceptance are not independent usefulness judgments. Distinct URLs may still describe the same opportunity; repeatedDestinations detects only observed redirect identity. Initial reports recorded a dashboard sample, not every source review.
